SAUDI AZM - SIGNS PARTNERSHIP AGREEMENT WITH ELM COMPANY
SAUDI AZM  - AGREEMENT AIMS TO DEVELOP AND IMPLEMENT HIGH-VALUE PROJECTS UNDER INNOVATIVE BUSINESS MODELS
SAUDI AZM  - AGREEMENT COMES AS AN EXTENSION OF EXISTING RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN TWO PARTIES AND BUILDS ON THEIR CURRENT JOINT PROJECTS AND INITIATIVES
SAUDI AZM  - TERM OF THE AGREEMENT IS FIVE (5) YEARS FROM ITS SIGNING DATE
SAUDI AZM  - AGREEMENT IS EXPECTED TO HAVE A POSITIVE FINANCIAL IMPACT DURING THIS YEAR
SAUDI AZM  - VALUE OF THE IMPACT CANNOT BE DETERMINED AT PRESENT TIME
